s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel. Mix 500g sausage meat with sage and pepper, wrap around each egg, roll in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs and fry at 170C for 8 minutes. Halve and serve with mustard.

s.note: Elinor as a bear learning to catch fish in the river
s.how: Spread oatcakes with cream cheese. Top with folds of smoked salmon and a sprig of dill. Squeeze over a little lemon and lay them out on a slate. Any bears in the house will want the lot.

m.how: Simmer 1kg lamb neck with 150g pearl barley in 2L water for an hour. Add 2 sliced leeks, 3 diced carrots and 2 diced turnips and simmer another hour. Shred the lamb back in, season well and stir through chopped parsley.

w.note: the cake from the witch that changes Elinor
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g honey, then 2 eggs. Fold in 200g self-raising flour, 50g rolled oats and a handful of raspberries. Bake at 175C for 40 minutes. Glaze with warm honey and set a single raspberry on top. Do not feed it to your mum.

d.how: Toast 2 tbsp rolled oats in a dry pan until golden. Blend 200g raspberries with 750ml cold milk, 2 tbsp honey and most of the oats until smooth. Pour into tall glasses, top with whipped cream and the rest of the oats.
